_note_compute_ops_removed_2026_08_19: REMOVED (user decision 2026-08-19, plan A). Two ops were deleted because the engine was producing values that the benchmark scores as gold arguments, which erases the very deficit we measure ([[62]]), and because one constant was fitted to gold ([[23]]). (1) file_debit_card_transaction_dispute.customer_max_liability_amount used thr=30 days while the policy text says 'within 2 business days of statement'; the note below records the threshold was chosen by gold reproduction rate (T1=2 -> 73.6% vs T1=30 -> 89.4%, and bank_rule_fit.py sweeps thresholds against reward_info.action_checks). (2) submit_interest_discrepancy_report.amount_difference computed (expected_apy - actual_apy)/100 * balance, i.e. the engine filled a scored argument outright. Live evidence in run bank_t7326_*_20260819q: '[T2_RESOLVE] compute silent-repair customer_max_liability_amount -1->50' fired 8 times in task_085. The policy tables themselves stay legal as DELIVERED TEXT (surface the doc_036/_031 wording to the model); what is forbidden is the engine writing the value into the call. The historical note is kept below for provenance, not as a licence.

function_agents.name: policy_qa
function_agents.instructions: You are a knowledge-base lookup specialist for a bank agent. The main agent issued the tool call shown below to look up policy/procedure information from the knowledge base. Use the provided search tools, read the results, and produce a direct, complete answer to what the main agent was trying to find out. Include every concrete detail the main agent would need (exact steps, required fields, thresholds, statuses).
function_agents.return_contract: Respond ONLY with a single JSON object: {"answer": "<direct, complete answer>", "quotes": ["<1-3 VERBATIM excerpts copied character-for-character from the KB documents that support the answer>"], "found": true|false}. If the knowledge base does not contain the information, set found=false and say so in answer.

write_evidence_specs.feedback: Error: [WRITE-EVIDENCE] no tool output in this conversation shows a dispute for transaction {id} that is resolved in the customer's favor — a customer's verbal claim is NOT evidence. isolate.instructions:
You determine cash-back reward rates by reading this bank's reward-rate policy documents.
FIRST search the knowledge base for the reward-rate policy of EACH card below — including its exceptions/exclusions — using the search tool. Search before you answer; do not answer from memory.
Then, for EACH item, report ONLY these values, read from the policy documents:
- base_rate: the base cash-back rate that applies to THIS item, as a percent number (e.g. 10 for 10%, 4 for 4%, 0 if this item earns nothing). It depends on the card, the purchase category, the merchant (policies may exclude specific merchants), and how long a subscription has run.
- promo_mult, promo_window_months, promo_start, promo_end: if a limited-time promo (e.g. double cash back for new customers) exists for this card, its multiplier, window length in months, and the promo period dates (MM/DD/YYYY). If no promo exists, use promo_mult=1 and empty dates.
★Do NOT compute the final rate, do NOT apply the promo, do NOT multiply, and do NOT judge whether the promo dates apply — a deterministic system does all of that. Report only what the documents say.
★Cards often list DIFFERENT rates per purchase category (e.g. a boosted rate for some categories and a base rate for everything else). For each item you MUST use the rate matching THAT item's category, quoting the category-specific rate line — quoting the base-rate line for a boosted-category purchase is the most common error and silently hides real discrepancies. If you cannot find a documented rate for an item, answer null for that item's base_rate instead of guessing — a wrong rate is worse than an unverified row.

scaffold_get_tools.name: verify_identity
scaffold_get_tools.description: USE THIS to check whether a customer's identity is verified before accessing their account, per Rho-Bank policy: at least 2 of {date_of_birth, address, phone_number, email} they PROVIDED must match their account record (full name or user ID alone is NOT enough). You can only look up a customer by NAME, EMAIL, or USER ID — there is NO lookup by phone or DOB, so if the customer only gave a phone/DOB, ASK them for their name, email, or user ID first, then call get_user_information_by_name/by_email/by_id to fetch the record, and finally call this tool. It tells you VERIFIED or NOT_VERIFIED.

params.provided: JSON object of ALL identity values the customer has given you at ANY point in this conversation — accumulate across turns and NEVER drop one they gave earlier. Keys where available: date_of_birth, address, phone_number, email. Example: if they gave their phone number three turns ago and their date of birth just now, pass BOTH.
params.record: JSON object of the customer's ACCOUNT RECORD you retrieved (via get_user_information_by_name/email/id), using the same keys: date_of_birth, address, phone_number, email.

op.met_template: VERIFIED — {count} identity values match ({matched}); you may now call log_verification.
op.unmet_template: NOT_VERIFIED — only {count} of the required {threshold} identity values match so far (matched: {matched}). Ask the customer for ONE more of: {missing} — then call verify_identity again passing ALL values they have given so far in this conversation. If you have not looked up the record yet, ask for their name, email, or user ID (phone/DOB cannot be used to look up), fetch the record, and try again.

scaffold_get_tools.missing_hint: NOT_VERIFIED — provide 'provided' (values the customer gave) and 'record' (fetched via get_user_information_by_name/email/id) as JSON with keys date_of_birth/address/phone_number/email.

Look the customer up with get_user_information_by_name/by_email/by_id, then call this tool again. Use a DIFFERENT identifier each time — repeating the same lookup arguments cannot change the result. If every identifier the customer can give returns no records, STOP calling these tools: tell the customer you cannot locate their account and ask them for another identifier; if they have none, say the account cannot be verified and follow the policy for that situation. scaffold_get_tools.name: check_rebate_qualification
scaffold_get_tools.description: ALWAYS provide user_id/credit_card_account_id (so the tool can verify against the records itself). USE THIS to determine whether a customer qualifies for a spend-threshold annual fee rebate (e.g. the Platinum Rewards Card annual fee rebate). Do NOT eyeball the monthly totals yourself. First read the customer's transactions and their card account opening date, and look up the required monthly spending threshold from the knowledge base, then call this tool. It buckets every transaction into the anniversary-based monthly windows of the cardmember year (by posting date, from the opening date), sums each window, and returns QUALIFIES only if EVERY window meets the threshold (a single month below disqualifies; no proration). Call get_current_time first and pass today's date as as_of_date - the tool evaluates the last complete cardmember year as of that date.

params.transactions: A JSON array of the card's transactions you read from the records. Each element MUST have ONLY these raw fields, copied as-is: date (string, the POSTING date, MM/DD/YYYY), amount (number, the purchase/spend amount, no $). Copy every transaction in the cardmember year; do not pre-filter or pre-sum. If you provide user_id and credit_card_account_id, you may OMIT this — the tool will read the transactions itself.
params.account_opening_date: The date the credit card account was opened (MM/DD/YYYY), copied from the account record. Monthly windows are anchored to this date.
params.monthly_threshold: The required per-month spending threshold for the rebate, as a plain number (no $), copied from the applicable rebate policy document in the knowledge base.
params.user_id: The customer user id (needed only if you omit transactions - the tool will read the card transactions itself).
params.credit_card_account_id: The credit card account id whose transactions should be checked (needed only if you omit transactions).
params.as_of_date: Today's date (MM/DD/YYYY), copied from get_current_time. The tool evaluates the LAST COMPLETE cardmember year as of this date.

scaffold_get_tools.return_template: Rebate qualification, computed deterministically over every anniversary monthly window of the cardmember year (by posting date): {result}. The customer qualifies only if EVERY month met the threshold; a single month below disqualifies (no proration).

scaffold_get_tools.name: get_correct_savings_apy
scaffold_get_tools.description: ALWAYS provide savings_account_type/customer_products (so the tool can verify against the records itself). USE THIS to compute the correct APY on a savings account under Rho-Bank stacking rules. Do NOT add the boosts up yourself. First read the savings account's base APY and identify EVERY applicable boost from the knowledge base — checking-account APY boosts (from the checking+savings pairing table), credit card APY bonuses, relationship bonuses, and account tier bonuses — then call this tool. It applies the stacking policy: only the HIGHEST checking boost counts, only the HIGHEST card bonus counts, while relationship and tier bonuses all add on top. If you provide savings_account_type and customer_products, you may OMIT components - the tool will search the knowledge base itself.

params.components: A JSON array of the APY components you read from the knowledge base for THIS savings account. Each element: {kind: one of 'base'|'checking'|'card'|'relationship'|'tier', value: <number, percentage points, no %>, source: <verbatim quote from the KB doc stating this value>}. Include the base APY as {kind:'base', value:<base>} and EVERY applicable boost (list all checking boosts and all card bonuses you find; the tool keeps only the highest of each per policy). Do not pre-select or pre-sum.
params.savings_account_type: The savings account's type/name (e.g. from the account record). Needed only if you omit components - the tool will look up the components itself.
params.customer_products: Short summary of the customer's boost-relevant products copied from their records (checking account type, credit card type, tenure/tier). Needed only if you omit components.
params.current_balance: The savings account's current balance (number, from the account record). The base APY may be tiered by balance, so the tool's extraction step needs it to pick the right tier. Needed only if you omit components.

scaffold_get_tools.return_template: Correct savings APY computed from the components supplied in this call: {result}%. The stacking policy is base + highest checking boost + highest card bonus + all relationship/tier bonuses. Compare this to the APY the system actually applied; if they differ, the difference is an interest discrepancy.

scaffold_get_tools.name: get_interest_correction
scaffold_get_tools.description: ALWAYS provide account_id (so the tool can verify against the records itself). USE THIS to compute the dollar interest correction owed when a savings account was paid the wrong APY. Do NOT do this arithmetic yourself. Provide the correct APY (from get_correct_savings_apy), the APY the system actually applied, the account principal/balance, and the period over which the wrong APY was applied. It returns the interest difference to credit. The correction amount = principal x (expected_apy - actual_apy)/100 / 12, i.e. ONE monthly interest credit difference (this account family credits interest MONTHLY at APY/12). If multiple months were wrong, call once per month.

params.expected_apy: The correct APY (percentage points, no %) — from get_correct_savings_apy.
params.actual_apy: The APY the system ACTUALLY applied (percentage points, no %). Derive it from the latest MONTHLY INTEREST CREDIT in the transactions: monthly credit amount x 12 / principal x 100. The APY stated on the account record may be the intended rate, NOT the rate actually applied - use the stated value only if no interest credit transaction is available.
params.principal: The savings account balance the APY applies to (number, no $), copied from the account record.
params.period_start: Start date (MM/DD/YYYY) of the affected MONTHLY interest credit period (for the record; the correction is computed as one monthly credit: principal x (expected-actual)% / 12).
params.period_end: End date (MM/DD/YYYY) of the affected monthly period (the month whose interest credit used the wrong APY).
params.account_id: The savings account id in question (e.g. from the account record). Needed only if you omit principal/actual_apy - the tool will read them from the records itself.

scaffold_get_tools.return_template: Interest correction (ONE monthly credit difference; this account credits interest MONTHLY at APY/12): principal={principal}, applied(actual) APY={actual_apy}%, correct(expected) APY={expected_apy}%. Correction amount = principal x (expected-actual)/100 / 12 = {result}. Use this as the credit amount and the amount_difference, and use these APY values in the discrepancy report.
scaffold_get_tools.result_range_feedback: Error: [RESULT-SIGN] this correction computes to {result}, which is not greater than {min_exclusive}, so it is not a credit amount. You passed correct(expected) APY={expected_apy}% and applied(actual) APY={actual_apy}% on principal={principal}. The credit tool's own argument contract is "amount (number): The positive dollar amount to credit (must be greater than 0)", so this number cannot be passed to it - and flipping its sign would credit the customer for interest they were never short-paid. What to do: if you are not certain the correct APY is right, re-read the account record with get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id and recompute the correct APY with get_correct_savings_apy, then call this tool again with the corrected values. If the applied APY really is the higher of the two, then no interest correction is owed for this period - tell the customer that instead of applying any credit.
scaffold_get_tools._note_result_range: ★2026-08-22 A8 / OL-11 (t7336 마스터 §6.1). 093#1 실측 — `expected<actual` 이면 이 계산은 **음수**를 내는데 `return_template` 이 "Use this as the credit amount" 으로 지시한다. 크레딧 도구의 인자 계약은 정책 축자 `doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_017` · `_043`: "amount (number): The positive dollar amount to credit (must be greater than 0)" (`a2/banking_knowledge.policy_facts.json` 의 인용 행 — 코퍼스 감사 x453 의 `quote_in` 검산 통과분·gold 무참조) ⇒ 현행 지시는 **집행 불가능**이다([[25]] 우리 도구는 100% 정답 의무·[[64]] 거부는 고칠 방법을 담아야 한다). 술어는 산수 하나(`result <= min_exclusive`)이고 경계값·문면은 전부 이 선언이라 엔진 리터럴 0 이다. 엔진은 *무엇이 옳은 APY 인가* 를 말하지 않는다 — 이 수를 크레딧 인자로 쓸 수 없다는 사실과 다시 확인할 read/계산의 **이름**만 준다([[62]] ④ 준수). ⚠[[70]] 무엇을 파는가: **정당한 음수 케이스**(과지급 환수·보고서의 음수 `amount_difference`)에서도 이 도구가 값을 안 돌려준다 — 그 케이스가 실재하는지는 **미측정**이다(다음 런 포렌식의 물음). 끄기 = `T2_SG_RESULT_RANGE=0`(A/B 전용·기본 ON·[[60]]). 셀 것 = `[T2_SG_RESULT_RANGE]` 발화 수·그 뒤 크레딧 write 부호·abstain 이 먹은 턴 수·093#1 재현.

scaffold_get_tools.name: check_card_closure_eligibility
scaffold_get_tools.description: USE THIS before closing a credit card account to determine whether the account is eligible for closure. The closure protocol disqualifies closing an account that still has an outstanding balance — the balance must be paid in full FIRST. Read the credit card account record, then call this tool with the account id and the outstanding balance copied from the record (plus the verbatim line from the record showing that balance). It returns the deterministic eligibility verdict.

params.credit_card_account_id: The credit card account id being closed, copied from the account record.
params.outstanding_balance: The account's current outstanding balance (number, no $), copied EXACTLY from the account record. If you just paid the balance, re-read the account record first and copy the NEW balance.
params.balance_source: The verbatim line/snippet from the account record (tool output) showing this balance. Copy it exactly — it is checked against the records.

scaffold_get_tools.return_template: Closure eligibility for credit card account {credit_card_account_id} (outstanding balance {outstanding_balance}): {result}

then.value: CLOSURE_OK — no outstanding balance; the balance requirement of the closure protocol is satisfied.

else.value: CLOSURE_BLOCKED_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE — this account still has an outstanding balance. Per the closure protocol the balance must be paid in full before the account can be closed. YOU (the agent) can execute the payment: search the knowledge base for how to pay a credit card balance from the customer's checking account — there is a DISCOVERABLE agent tool for this (unlock it via unlock_discoverable_agent_tool with its full name including the numeric suffix, then call it via call_discoverable_agent_tool, with the customer's consent). Do NOT tell the customer to pay through the app themselves. After paying, re-read the account record and call this tool again with the new balance.

scaffold_get_tools.missing_hint: COULD NOT VERIFY — the balance you provided could not be verified against the account records. Re-read the credit card account record and copy the outstanding balance and its verbatim source line exactly.
scaffold_get_tools._note: 2026-07-20 관문3(043·§2aa 요건②③): 종단행동(close)을 '체크했나'가 아닌 **실제 실격조건(잔액>0)**으로 게이트하는 calc-offload 반쪽. LLM=잔액 copy+축자인용(유동)·엔진=compare+if_then(결정론·3-값=미검증 abstain). 반환문이 id+판정토큰 에코→WEV(require_tokens=CLOSURE_OK)의 증거 채널(user_id-키/id-공존 불성립 해소). 잔액0 날조=source_param 축자검증이 차단(존재검사는 0-편재로 무력). 토큰 비중첩(CLOSURE_OK ⊄ CLOSURE_BLOCKED_OUTSTANDING_BALANCE). ★e2e9 043 포렌식(§2an): 구 else 문구 'Have the customer pay'가 오답 경로(사용자 앱 떠넘김→영원 대기)를 직접 유도 — gold=에이전트-측 pay 도구(discoverable) 실행. 문구=KB 검색 지시(도구명 직접 주지 않음·발견은 에이전트 몫·spoon-feed 아님)+unlock 프로토콜 안내.

scaffold_get_tools.name: check_cli_eligibility
scaffold_get_tools.description: USE THIS before deciding (approve or deny) a credit limit increase request. It applies the tier CLI eligibility policy deterministically: minimum account age, cooldown after the most recent APPROVED request, maximum utilization, and consecutive on-time payment months. First read the credit card account record, the CLI request history, and the payment history; then call this tool with values copied EXACTLY from those tool outputs. It returns the policy verdict; you then execute the decision with the approve/deny tool.

params.credit_card_account_id: The credit card account id, from the account record.
params.card_type: The card_type string copied exactly from the credit card account record.
params.date_of_account_open: The date_of_account_open from the account record, exactly as shown.
params.current_balance: The current balance as a plain number (no $ or commas), from the account record.
params.credit_limit: The credit limit as a plain number (no $ or commas), from the account record.
params.consecutive_on_time_payments: The 'Consecutive on-time payments' number from the payment history tool output.
params.last_approved_cli_submitted_date: Look at the CLI request history tool output. Among the requests whose status is 'approved', copy the most recent submitted_date (as shown, e.g. 2025-09-15). The request the customer just submitted in THIS conversation has status 'pending' (not 'approved'), so it is automatically excluded - do not confuse it with a prior approval. Pass 'none' ONLY if NO request in the history has status 'approved'.

scaffold_get_tools.missing_hint: COULD NOT VERIFY - one or more inputs are missing or unparseable, so no verdict is given. Re-read the account record, the CLI request history and the payment history, then call again with exact values (balances/limits as plain numbers, dates exactly as shown, 'none' for the last-approved date only if no approved prior request exists).

then.value: NOT_ELIGIBLE_ACCOUNT_AGE - the account has not been open long enough for a CLI at this card tier ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the requirement to the customer.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_UTILIZATION - the current balance exceeds the tier's maximum utilization of the credit limit at request time ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the utilization requirement.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_PAYMENT_HISTORY - the consecutive on-time payment months are below this tier's requirement ('CLI Payment History and Approval Criteria'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the payment-history requirement.

else.value: ELIGIBLE - all tier requirements (account age, cooldown, utilization, payment history) are satisfied. Decide with a TOOL CALL: approve_credit_limit_increase, choosing the new limit within the tier's maximum increase cap from the CLI policy documents - or deny only if a different documented requirement fails.

then.value: NOT_ELIGIBLE_COOLDOWN - the tier cooldown since the most recent APPROVED credit limit increase request has not elapsed ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier': the cooldown counts from the last approved request's submission date; denied requests do not trigger it). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and tell the customer when they can reapply.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_UTILIZATION - the current balance exceeds the tier's maximum utilization of the credit limit at request time ('CLI Eligibility Requirements by Card Tier'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the utilization requirement.

NOT_ELIGIBLE_PAYMENT_HISTORY - the consecutive on-time payment months are below this tier's requirement ('CLI Payment History and Approval Criteria'). Per policy the request must be DENIED: unlock and call deny_credit_limit_increase with an appropriate denial_reason, and explain the payment-history requirement.

else.value: ELIGIBLE - all tier requirements (account age, cooldown, utilization, payment history) are satisfied. scaffold_get_tools.name: check_card_application_fit
scaffold_get_tools.description: MANDATORY before recommending or applying for ANY credit card: formalize the customer's stated constraints (max annual fee, max foreign-transaction fee %, max minimum-payment %, min cashback %, their credit score, business vs personal) and call this tool. It deterministically filters Rho-Bank's documented card catalog and returns three buckets: 'eligible' (the documented value satisfies your constraint, with source docs), 'excluded' (it violates it, with the reason), and 'unverified' (that fact is NOT documented for that card). A card in 'unverified' is NOT known to meet the constraint you asked about — never tell the customer that it does, and only consider it after reading its cited source docs. Choose ONLY among the eligible cards; verify each remaining candidate's source docs for conditional clauses (e.g. subscriber discounts) and the customer's soft preferences before the final pick. The card_type you then pass to apply_for_credit_card MUST be one of the eligible cards you named to the customer.

params.min_cashback: number, optional (percent) — ONLY a number the customer explicitly stated as a minimum. A superlative request ('the highest cash back') is NOT a threshold: leave this out, then compare the cashback facts across the eligible cards yourself (mind cashback_scope — a category-limited rate is not comparable to an all-purchases rate).
params.min_credit_limit: number, optional — the minimum credit limit the customer needs to be possible
params.needs_purchase_protection: boolean, optional — true if the customer requires purchase protection
params.premium_subscriber: boolean, optional — true if the customer has the bank's premium subscription (some fees are waived for subscribers); omit if unknown
params.spend_category: optional string — ONLY if the customer stated a clear spending emphasis, the ONE documented category keyword it maps to. Documented keywords: travel, software, operations, media_advertising, green (=sustainable/eco). Normalize synonyms to these exact keywords (flights/hotels/airfare -> travel; SaaS/cloud -> software; eco/sustainable -> green). Omit entirely if the customer stated no category emphasis — do NOT guess one. When provided, each eligible card is annotated with its documented rate for that category so you can compare them honestly (a category-limited bonus is not comparable to an all-purchases rate).
params.spend_amount: optional number — ONLY if the customer stated how much they will spend (a dollar amount they gave verbatim); the amount that spending applies to. Omit entirely if they stated no amount — do NOT estimate one. When both this and spend_category are given, each candidate is annotated with the return its own documented rates produce for that spending, with the arithmetic shown.
params.spend_category_quote: optional string — REQUIRED whenever you set spend_category: a sentence copied word for word from a document YOU retrieved that shows this spending qualifies for that category. If you have not retrieved such a document, omit spend_category (the base rate is used) or search for the category's defining document first.

scaffold_get_tools.name: get_atm_fee_discrepancies
scaffold_get_tools.description: ALWAYS use this whenever a customer questions or disputes ATM fees on their checking account(s) and you need to find which specific fee lines were charged incorrectly. First retrieve the account's transactions, then call this ONCE PER ACCOUNT, passing the account's id and its level (class) and ONE element per ATM withdrawal - including the withdrawals that carry no fee line, because a fee that is MISSING is one of the errors it finds. It derives the correct fee under the documented fee schedule for that account level, applies that level's documented free-withdrawal allowance and ATM fee rebate programme, and does the arithmetic for you. Do the fee math with this tool - do not eyeball it yourself.

params.account_id: string (required) - the checking account ID being audited (e.g. from the accounts listing); used to look up its transaction records.
params.account_class: The account's level exactly as shown in the account record (e.g. 'Blue Account', 'Light Green Account').
params.transactions: A JSON array with ONE element per atm_withdrawal record of THIS account, in any order - this tool sorts them by date itself. Include EVERY atm_withdrawal, also the ones with no fee line - a fee that is MISSING is one of the errors, and this account level's free-withdrawal allowance is counted over the withdrawals you pass. Each element MUST have ONLY these fields, copied from the records: date (string - this withdrawal's date exactly as the record shows it, e.g. '11/14/2025'), transaction_id (string - the id of the atm_fee line paired with this withdrawal; if this withdrawal has NO fee line, the withdrawal's own id), fee_amount (number - that fee line's amount as a POSITIVE number, no $; 0 if this withdrawal has no fee line), withdrawal_amount (number, POSITIVE - the cash dispensed by this atm_withdrawal), network (string, exactly one of 'rho' | 'non_rho' | 'foreign', read from that withdrawal's description: a RHO-BANK machine is 'rho'; a machine outside the U.S. or dispensing foreign currency is 'foreign'; any other bank's machine is 'non_rho'), rebate_amount (number - the amount of the fee_rebate line paired with this withdrawal, as a POSITIVE number; 0 if the history shows no rebate for it). Do NOT compute anything - just copy the raw values; this tool computes the expected fee and finds discrepancies itself. IMPORTANT: the fee line's own description (e.g. 'NON-RHO ATM FEE') is exactly what you are auditing - it may be wrong. Determine 'network' ONLY from the paired withdrawal's description: a RHO-BANK machine is 'rho' (a fee on a RHO-BANK withdrawal is itself the error you are looking for), a machine outside the U.S. is 'foreign', any other bank's machine is 'non_rho'. Also: if TWO fee lines belong to the SAME withdrawal, include that withdrawal twice, and add "duplicate_of": "<the other fee line's transaction_id>" on the second one, with rebate_amount 0 on it.

scaffold_get_tools.return_template: ATM withdrawals whose net charge does NOT match the documented fee schedule for this account level: {details}. SCOPE OF THIS CHECK - each withdrawal you passed in was compared against the documented schedule for this level, which covers a fee charged when none was due, a fee of the wrong amount, a fee that is MISSING where one was due (it shows as a negative difference), the level's documented free-withdrawal allowance, and - for levels whose documents promise ATM fee rebates - a documented rebate the history does not show (for those levels both amounts shown are net of the fee_rebate lines you passed, so a missing rebate shows as a positive difference). It covers ONLY the withdrawals you passed in: if you left an atm_withdrawal of this account out, its error is not in this list and the free-allowance count may be off - pass them all and call again. If corrections are owed, the credit policy requires ONE fee_refund credit for the net correction of THIS account (do not credit the same lines twice). The signed total of the differences listed above, computed by this tool, is {delta_total} (a negative difference lowers it). That signed total is the net correction for THIS account - use it as the credit amount; do not re-add the figures by hand.

isolate.instructions: You are a records-extraction sub-task. For the checking account in REFERENCE: (1) call call_discoverable_agent_tool with agent_tool_name='get_bank_account_transactions_9173' and that account_id to read the account's transaction records. (2) Build the transactions array with ONE element per atm_withdrawal record of THIS account. Order does not matter - the tool sorts by date itself, so just copy them as the records list them. Include EVERY atm_withdrawal, also the ones with no fee line. Each element MUST have ONLY these fields, copied from the records: date (string - this withdrawal's date exactly as the record shows it, e.g. '11/14/2025'), transaction_id (string - the id of the atm_fee line paired with this withdrawal: the adjacent atm_fee record with the same account and date; if this withdrawal has NO fee line, the withdrawal's own id), fee_amount (number - that fee line's amount as a POSITIVE number, no $; 0 if this withdrawal has no fee line), withdrawal_amount (number, POSITIVE - the cash dispensed by this atm_withdrawal), network (string, exactly one of 'rho' | 'non_rho' | 'foreign'), rebate_amount (number - the amount of the fee_rebate record with the same account and date, as a POSITIVE number; 0 if there is none). IMPORTANT: the fee line's own description (e.g. 'NON-RHO ATM FEE') is exactly what you are auditing - it may be wrong. Determine 'network' ONLY from the paired withdrawal's description: a RHO-BANK machine is 'rho' (a fee on a RHO-BANK withdrawal is itself the error you are looking for), a machine outside the U.S. is 'foreign', any other bank's machine is 'non_rho'. Also: if TWO fee lines belong to the SAME withdrawal, include that withdrawal twice, and add "duplicate_of": "<the other fee line's transaction_id>" on the second one, with rebate_amount 0 on it. Do NOT compute fees - just copy raw values.
isolate.answer_format: Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"transactions": [ {"date": "...", "transaction_id": "...", "fee_amount": <number>, "withdrawal_amount": <number>, "network": "...", "rebate_amount": <number>} ]}

scaffold_get_tools.return_template_short: ATM withdrawals whose net charge does NOT match the documented fee schedule for this account level: {details}. SCOPE OF THIS CHECK - each withdrawal you passed in was compared against the documented schedule for this level, which covers a fee charged when none was due, a fee of the wrong amount, a fee that is MISSING where one was due (it shows as a negative difference), the level's documented free-withdrawal allowance, and - for levels whose documents promise ATM fee rebates - a documented rebate the history does not show (for those levels both amounts shown are net of the fee_rebate lines you passed, so a missing rebate shows as a positive difference). It covers ONLY the withdrawals you passed in: if you left an atm_withdrawal of this account out, its error is not in this list and the free-allowance count may be off - pass them all and call again. If corrections are owed, the credit policy requires ONE fee_refund credit for the net correction of THIS account (do not credit the same lines twice). This audit is INCOMPLETE and states no net correction: {missing} of the {read} {kind} record(s) that were read for this account did not reach the check, so any total computed from the lines above would be short. scaffold_get_tools.name: get_checking_atm_fee_totals
scaffold_get_tools.description: MANDATORY before recommending which personal checking account class to open (or keep) when the customer's stated criterion involves ATM fees: formalize the customer's stated usage pattern and call this ONCE. It computes, from the documented per-class fee schedules, each class's out-of-network ATM fee total and foreign ATM fee total for that usage (documented monthly free allowances deducted). It does NOT rank or pick a class - compare the returned totals yourself against what the customer asked to minimize, check the candidate class's other documented terms (eligibility, minimum deposits, monthly fees) in its source docs, and confirm the choice with the customer. Do the fee math with this tool - do not eyeball it yourself.

params.months: number - how many months the customer's usage pattern covers (their stated trip/usage duration).
params.withdrawals_per_month: number - the customer's stated ATM withdrawals per month.
params.withdrawal_amount: number - the customer's stated typical amount per withdrawal in USD (no $).

op.row_template: - {account_class}: out-of-network ATM total ${out_of_network_total_usd:.2f} | foreign ATM total ${foreign_atm_total_usd:.2f} ({source})

view_field_annotations.note: [FIELD NOTE] This record shows BOTH account_status: ACTIVE and status: CLOSED. Per the knowledge base ('What Happens When You Order a Replacement Card'): ordering a replacement cancels the current CARD and issues a new one, while 'your account number remains unchanged' and account functions continue. Do not treat a replaced/cancelled card as a closed ACCOUNT - the account's state is account_status. Account-level operations (e.g. credit limit requests) are governed by their own knowledge-base eligibility criteria, which do not include any card-replacement condition.

discoverable_name_check._note_not_discoverable: ★2026-08-05 오발화 교정(x99: 이 레버는 **7발 7오발화**). 대상이 전부 discoverable이 아닌 일반 도구였다 — `verify_identity`(017·028)·`check_cli_eligibility`(050). 019는 t2에서 이 메시지를 받고 신원 검증을 잃었다(gold의 log_verification·submit_cash_back_dispute 둘 다 미호출). env가 agent-discoverable 44종을 **목록으로** 주는데 우리는 철자 규칙(`_\d+$`)으로 대신했다 — 닫힌 사실은 권위 출처에서 읽는다([[22]]·C279 '패턴 규칙은 조용한 오탐'). 이름이 목록의 어떤 것과도 대응하지 않고 그 이름의 도구가 실재하면 이 문구를 쓴다.
discoverable_name_check.feedback_resolved: Error: '{name}' is missing its numeric suffix, so it was not looked up. The full registry name is {exact} - retry the unlock with exactly that name. discoverable_name_check._note_feedback_resolved: ★2026-08-05 지시-모순 교정(x95 정적 감사 + 048 로그). 구판은 *'You do NOT know the suffix - search the knowledge base NOW'* 라고 **단정**했는데, 같은 대화의 절차 문구는 *'the name above is complete - do not search'* 를 준다. 048은 **두 지시를 다 따라** 중복 검색 8회를 쓰고 40여 메시지를 잃었다 — 모델의 불이행이 아니라 **우리 결정론의 버그**다([[55]]). 레지스트리에서 이름이 풀리면 `feedback_resolved`(이 키)를 쓰고, 못 풀 때만 종전 `feedback`. 이름 해석은 엔진의 `_resolve_exact`가 env agent-discoverable 집합으로 하고 **모호하면 침묵**한다.

discoverable_name_check._note: 2026-07-21 §2bh (rall5 실측·§2bf 철회 근거): FOLLOWUP CAP3+FORCE는 행동을 움직였다 - 모델이 dispute_history·pending_orders unlock을 sim당 3회 시도. 전부 bare-name→env 'Unknown tool'→포기 반복(6 sim×2도구×3회). 마지막 고리=이름-형식. 생성-레벨 deny(비커밋·replay-clean)+required regen으로 KB-검색 유도. 엔진=패턴 대조만(이름 리터럴 0·검색·선택=모델). give용 인자도 선언(031 계열 대비). ★2026-07-22 §2bm 교정: give(user-도구)는 접미사 無가 정상(e2e10 bare-give 성공 실증) — rall8 038서 정당 give 6회 오차단(give-flow 봉쇄→dispute 0)의 자해 실측 → give를 검사에서 제거(unlock만 잔류). ★2026-07-22 §2bs(rall10 050/052 실측): 舊문구 'query the tool's purpose or base name'의 base-name 질의=BM25 score 0.0(문서에 도구명 토큰 부재)→deny→검색실패 마찰 루프가 FOLLOWUP cap을 소모. env BM25 토크나이저는 upstream 벤치 고정([[05]]·비교가능성)이라 불가침 — 피드백이 자연어 질의를 직접 예시({name_words}=엔진 일반 파생: suffix 제거+언더스코어→공백)하는 것으로 교정. 접미사 자체는 여전히 미제공(발견=모델+KB 몫).

discoverable_name_check._note_feedback_user_registry_listing: 2026-08-22 A13/OL-05 (t7336 마스터 §6.1). 구판 feedback_user_tool_is_agents 는 손님-측 레지스트리를 **한 번도 조회하지 않은 채** "there is no customer-side tool by that name on file" 을 단언했다 — _tok_overlap 은 토큰 하나('deposit')만 겹쳐도 최대-겹침 항목을 돌려주므로, 손님 도구 deposit_check_3847 이 **실재**하는데 그 거짓이 055#0(지연)·055#1(치명·give 재시도 0)에 나갔다([[25]] "우리 도구는 100% 정답 의무" 위반). 이 키는 그 자리에 쓰는 **사실만의 대체 문면**이다: 부정 존재 단언 0 · {names} 는 env user_tools (discoverable ∪ 전체)의 **기계 나열**이고 무엇을 건넬지는 모델이 고른다([[62]] ③④ · [[64]] 거부는 해법을 담는다). 출처 = env 레지스트리 API 뿐 — 정책 산문·gold 경유 0([[23]]). 엔진 술어(닫힘·[[22]]): 인자 k ∈ user_tool_channel_args ∧ 이름 토큰이 손님-측 레지스트리와 겹침 ⇒ 소유권 주장(agent 도구다)을 **접고** 이 목록을 준다. 조회 실패는 fail-open.
discoverable_name_check._note_feedback_user_tool_is_agents: 2026-08-13 FIX-7. 실물 = t7277 075 엔진로그 118행: 착수 시도가 give_discoverable_user_tool(discoverable_tool_name='open_account') 였는데 우리 문구는 feedback_not_discoverable("unlock_ 은 적용 안 된다"+레지스트리 45개)로 **채널이 어긋난** 말을 했고, 그 이름이 사실 에이전트 자신의 도구(open_bank_account_4821)라는 사실을 말하지 않아 수동 안내로 접혔다. 격리 x298(3셀 n=8·사전등록): A_LIVE 1/8 · B_OWN 6/8 · D_BARE 0/8. 술어는 닫힘([[22]]): 손님-측 인자 키(user_tool_channel_args) ∧ 이름 토큰이 에이전트 레지스트리와 겹침(_tok_overlap·기계·판단 0). 겹침 없으면 침묵(fail-open)·무엇을 호출할지는 모델 몫([[62]] ③④). 문면은 측정 축자 그대로([[03b]]). ★2026-08-22 A13/OL-05 교정: 첫 절의 부정 존재 단언("there is no customer-side tool by that name on file")을 **삭제**했다 — 우리는 그 사실을 확인하지 않고 말하고 있었다. 엔진은 이제 _user_discoverable/_user_all_tools 로 **선조회**하고, 손님-측에 후보가 겹치면 이 문면을 접고 feedback_user_registry_listing 을 쓴다. 발화할 때는 feedback_registry_listing 을 **병기**해 단일 {matches} 로 몰지 않는다(선점 금지).

dispatcher_role_check._note: 2026-07-22 §2bl(rall8 031 실측): dispute를 user-디스패처로 제출·user-도구를 에이전트가 직접 호출 4회. 술어=대화 자기-이력(unlock/give 이벤트)로 이름의 역할 판정 — 엔진 이름-리터럴 0·A2=디스패처 5도구명+문구. || 2026-08-06 T1(소속 3갈래·정본 `CONFLICT_ARBITRATION_THEORY_2026_08_06` §3-T1). 구판은 give 대상이 discoverable이 아니면 **전부** 'YOUR OWN agent tools'라고 말했다. 손님이 **이미 보유한**(non-discoverable user) 도구가 그 문장에 걸려, 같은 턴의 다른 문구('그건 손님이 실행한다')와 **같은 명제에 두 진리값**을 냈다([[25]] 정본 오염). 출처([[23]]) = env 레지스트리 구조 축자: user_tools.get_discoverable_tools()는 user_tools.tools의 **부분집합**(toolkit.py: discoverable 표시가 붙은 것만) — 세 집합 소속으로 판정하므로 도메인 리터럴 0·gold 무참조. deny 여부는 불변, 문구만 사실에 맞춘다. ⚠env를 근거로 인용하지 않는다(사용자 지시 2026-08-06): 구판의 'the environment will reject it'을 삭제했다 — env는 외부 주장이고 우리 문구가 정본이어야 한다([[25]]).

prescription_redirect.feedback: Error: [PRESCRIPTION] the customer is describing a disputed or unauthorized charge. That is handled by FILING A FORMAL DISPUTE (file_credit_card_transaction_dispute), NOT by applying a statement credit. apply_statement_credit is only for goodwill adjustments, promotional credits, or fee reversals - never for disputing a charge. First file the dispute: it is a DISCOVERABLE tool, so find its full suffixed name in the knowledge base (search plain words like "file credit card dispute"), unlock it, and call it with the transaction and card details. Do not apply a statement credit for a disputed charge.
prescription_redirect._note: 2026-07-22 §2bu(rall11 038 실측·격리 L2 8/8): 사기청구 dispute 요청에 apply_statement_credit 오선택(dispute 미착수·gold=file_dispute). 격리=명시질의 시 file_dispute 8/8 앎=활성화 실패(능력·부하 아님). 게이트=dispute-신호∧file_dispute 미호출인데 statement_credit이면 deny+dispute 안내(nudge). KB=doc_014/017. requires_absent_tool=file_dispute 이미 호출 시 통과(dispute 후 정당 provisional credit 보호). ★[[05]] 회색: signals=dispute판정 근사(유동판단 동결 우려)·기본 OFF·Δspurious(정당 credit 오차단) rall12 계측. T2_PRESCRIPTION. ★signals 정제(test 자체발견): 'dispute' 단독=도구명(file_..._dispute)·KB 문서에 편재→over-fire 자기오염 → 제거. 사기-특정 어구만(unauthorized/fraudulent/did not make this/never made this/do not recognize 등). Δspurious 축소.

The check's own output is the record of what was found - a customer saying a charge looks fine to them does not change what the ledger showed. If you have decided not to dispute one of these, say plainly which one and why; do not simply leave it out.
withdrawn_row_check._note: G3(2026-08-05·019 t1 실측: 확정 3행 중 2행만 제출·하나는 손님 산문에 설득당해 철회). [[21]]의 **닫힌 절반** — 손님 문장은 읽지 않고 엔진 출력과 호출 이력만 본다. ⚠**F5 위에서만 건전하다**: x94 1차에서 gold 반례 2건이 나왔는데 둘 다 **오염된 입력**으로 나온 가짜 확정 행이었다(018/t0 1113 오기·028/t1 488). F5(불일치+날조 id)가 막는 호출의 출력은 확정으로 세지 않도록 배선했고, 그 조건에서 재판정하니 **반례 0**. 제출을 강제하지 않는다 — 표면화만([[10]]). ★2026-08-05 패턴 제거: 여기 있던 `id_pattern`은 JSON 백스페이스 이스케이프로 실려 **어떤 텍스트와도 매치되지 않았다**(엔진 폴백 정규식도 같은 오염) — 이 레버는 켜진 채 확정 행 0으로 죽어 있었고, x94는 자기 정규식을 따로 써서 그 사실을 못 봤다. 이제 엔진이 그 호출에서 계산한 id 목록을 그대로 받고(`_t2_sg_ids`), 제출 여부는 인자 값 멤버십으로 본다 — 철자 규칙 없음.

_source: doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_001 (How can I close a credit card account?)
procedures._quote_order: Check these in order: 1. Pending disputes … 2. No pending replacement cards … 3. Minimum account age … 4. Outstanding balance.
procedures._note_enforce: 정책이 Step 1에서 '이 순서로 확인하라'고 명령하고 Step 2가 그 다음임을 지정하므로 순서 강제의 허가가 있다. 허가 문장이 없으면 표면화만 한다.

enter_when._note: 이 절차에만 있는 도구로 진입한다. 공용 read(분쟁 이력·교체 주문)는 진입시키지 않는다 — x80이 잰 28건 과차단의 원인이 그것이었다.

nodes._quote: Pending disputes: The account must not have any active or pending transaction disputes.
No pending replacement cards: If a replacement has been ordered and not yet received or activated, a closure cannot proceed.
Use the get_closure_reason_history_8293 tool to determine whether this specific credit card account has any closure reason records within the past year.
Ask the customer why they want to close their account. Then log it using log_credit_card_closure_reason_4521.

Step 5: Make a Retention Offer — If the customer still wants to close after addressing their concerns, make one retention offer based on their card tier: Entry-tier 500 bonus points or a $5 statement credit; Mid-tier 2,000 or $20; Premium and above 5,000 or $50.
nodes._note: 어느 제안인지는 손님의 사유에 대한 해석이라 모델 몫이다([[52]]). 엔진은 이 단계가 **있었는지**만 본다 — 세 도구 중 어느 것이든 하나면 충족.

nodes._note_requires: ★정책 Step 2 축자: 'If records are found within the past year, inform the customer you will proceed with their closure request and move to Step 6.' — 즉 Step 3(사유 기록)~Step 5가 **조건부로 건너뛰어진다**. 그 조건은 도구 **출력 내용**에 달려 있어 우리 엔진엔 닫히지 않는다([[22]]). 그래서 무조건인 Step 2만 선행으로 걸고, 조건부인 log_reason·retention_offer는 체크리스트로 **표면화만** 한다. 구판은 log_reason을 필수로 걸어 gold 2태스크를 막았다(x91).
nodes._quote: Use the close_credit_card_account_7834 tool to process the closure.

Pending disputes 2. No pending replacement cards 3. Minimum account age 4. Outstanding balance'* 라는 **확인 4가지**이지 특정 도구 호출이 아니고, Step 2는 *'If records exist ... skip retention offers and proceed directly to processing the closure'* 로 **보유 제안의 우회를 명시**한다. 그 과잉 규정이 gold 경로를 6 태스크·47곳에서 막고 있었다(x91). 보유-제안은 조건이 도구 **출력 내용**에 달려 있어 우리에겐 닫히지 않으므로 **표면화만** 한다.

★절차 DAG(2026-08-05·사용자 지시 "절차 컨트롤러는 DAG로 만들어 A2 도메인 특화 파일에 기록하라").
**왜 데이터인가**: 정책이 단계·순서·도구명·숫자를 전부 축자로 준다 — 판단이 아니라 표 조회다. 엔진은 DAG를 걷고 미충족 선행 노드를 표면화할 뿐이고, 도메인 어휘는 여기에만 있다([[05]]).
**근거(축자)**: `_source`·`_quote_order`·노드별 `_quote` 참조. gold 경유 0 — 모든 값이 정책 문서에서 복사됐고, 정책이 주지 않는 것(카드명→등급 매핑)은 **일부러 비워** 모델 operand로 남겼다([[23]]/[[52]]).
**실측 표적**: 스모크 `task_051` — 요청 제출(1단계) 누락 · 분쟁 이력 미확인 · `months` 6→12 · 상한 25%를 넘는 승인(new_limit 5,200 = +30%). 네 결함이 모두 이 DAG의 노드에 대응한다.
⚠**현재는 데이터만이다** — 이 DAG를 걷는 엔진이 아직 없으므로 라이브 발화는 0이다. 엔진 없이 데이터만 두는 것이 이 repo의 死코드 패턴이므로([[24]]), 원장 F14에 '엔진 미구현'으로 남긴다.

It must be the full official name ending with Account' · 'Set account_class to the exact official name provided by the customer'. 즉 정책이 요구하는 것은 **공식 명칭 + 손님 확인**이지 *우리가 회수한 문서 안에 있음* 이 아니다 ⇒ 기존 술어가 **정책보다 좁았다**. account_class 는 열린 문자열이 아니라 형식이 닫혀 있다. 효과는 **미측정**이다.

arbitration._note_merged: 2026-08-07 C3 합병. 같은 표적을 덮는 요건이 여럿일 때 **한 문장**으로 낸다(명령 하나·사실 합집합). 근거 = 라이브 실측: 치환 24회가 **전부 GB1**이고 뒤에 선 게이트는 **0회**였다 — push의 발화 창이 좁아(검증 전·캡 소진 전) 늘 같은 게이트가 이기니 뒤 요건은 선언돼도 존재하지 않는 것과 같다. 순수 사전식 순서가 하위를 굶긴다는 것의 실측(Tercan & Prabhu ECAI 2024와 같은 형태). 출처([[23]]) = 도메인 사실을 주장하지 않는 **중재 문구**다. {items}에 들어가는 내용은 각 요건의 predicate와 satisfier 이름이고 전부 기존 선언(gates/require_tool_before/requires_reads)에서 온다 — **새 A2 키 0 · 도메인 어휘 0 · gold 무참조**. 부수 효과: 같은 행동 앞에 다른 선행 read를 요구하는 선언(task_100의 계좌 조회)이 **밀려나지 않는다**. || ★2026-08-07 정정: 초판은 미충족 요건을 **전부 명령형 목록**으로 냈다. task_101 turn 4 실측 — 네 요건을 한 번에 받은 모델이 **첫 항목만** 집어 신원 확인으로 갔고 나머지(원장 조회 포함)를 흘렸다. 그 뒤 열 턴이 신원 확인 왕복이었다. 경합은 없앴는데 **우선순위 없는 나열**이 되어 omission을 만들었다. [[56]]이 '명령은 하나, 사실은 합집합'이라 규정했는데 구현이 전부 명령이었다. ⇒ `{first}`만 명령, `{rest}`는 평서. 다음 턴에 다시 발화해 그 다음 요건으로 넘어간다.
arbitration._note: 2026-08-06 T2(근거-등급 중재·사용자 지시 "무조건 근거를 확보한 쪽이 우세하다"). 지배당한 push를 **침묵시키지 않고 치환**할 때 쓰는 문구. 출처([[23]]) = 이 문장은 도메인 사실을 주장하지 않는다 — {requirement}에 들어가는 내용은 **게이트 자신의 predicate**(정책 축자에서 온 A2 선언)이고 {target}은 모델이 고른 이름이라, 엔진도 이 문구도 도메인 어휘를 만들지 않는다. 침묵이 아닌 이유: 진공은 모델의 prior가 채운다 (012 실측 — 우리 deny가 일하던 문구의 트리거를 없앴다). 선행: 이행 불가가 된 커밋먼트는 공표 의무로 전환된다(Cohen & Levesque, Teamwork 1991) / 전제 미충족 행동에는 그 전제를 **삽입**한다(Ligatti, Bauer & Walker, Edit Automata 2005 §5.3 — 거절만으로는 집행 불가가 정리로 증명됨) / 치환은 억제와 다른 원시연산이다(Brooks 1986: suppression은 "provides a replacement", inhibition은 메시지가 사라진다).

suppression_authority._note: 2026-08-06 T5(억제 자격·정본 `CONFLICT_ARBITRATION_THEORY_2026_08_06` §3-T5). 출처([[23]]) = **우리 레버에 대한 메타 기록**이라 도메인 사실을 주장하지 않는다(도메인 리터럴 0·gold 무참조). 이 키는 능력을 더하지 않고 **뺀다** — 여기 없는 억제형 레버는 `T2_SUPPRESS_AUTH=1`에서 다른 레버를 침묵시킬 수 없다(표면화는 그대로). 근거는 정책 축자(kind=policy·quote) 또는 사전 등록 계량(kind=measurement·measure) 둘 중 하나여야 하고, **숫자 우선순위는 쓰지 않는다**(Davis & Buchanan 1977: 서로 다른 차원을 한 숫자로 뭉개면 그 숫자가 어떻게 나왔는지 기록이 남지 않는다). 이 규칙이 있었다면 C13 원판은 근거를 못 대 실격됐을 것이고 050/051의 이행을 만들던 반복을 지우지 못했을 것이다.

_note_relations: ★2026-08-08 4단계 — 선행 관계의 **유일한 원천**(정본 설계 `A3_POLICY_ONTOLOGY_DESIGN_2026_08_08` §1d.1). 여기 들어오면서 `require_tool_before`(L3)·`scaffold_get_tools[].requires_reads`(L3)·`gates[].satisfier_requires`(L2)를 **같은 커밋에서 삭제**했다 — 두 원천이 공존하는 창을 만들지 않기 위해서다([[24]] 2026-08-03: 정본만 고치고 소비자·사본을 안 맞추면 옛 값이 쓰인다). 키 수는 **순감**(3선언 → 1키)이고 도메인 리터럴 순증 0. 생성기 = `x144_build_relation_index.py`, 소비자 입구 = `t2_precedence.declarations` 하나(t2_pin_read·t2_prekb_patch·t2_dominance·t2_precedence). ★`declarations`는 **출처·순서·다중성**을 그대로 진다 — 간선으로 합치면 `t2_pin_read._refcount`가 세는 *선언 개수*가 2→1이 되어 조준이 바뀐다. ★재생성: `x144 --domain <d> --out -`로 다시 만들되, **삭제 전 기준선**(`a2/frozen/banking_knowledge.prereq_baseline.json`)과 `--check-snapshot`으로 맞대야 한다. 삭제 후에는 원천이 없어 *'원천 vs 인덱스'* 대조가 공허하게 참이 되기 때문이다.

axes.referrer_tenure_days: the minimum number of days the REFERRER must already have held a checking account (relationship duration / tenure) to be eligible to refer
axes.annual_referral_limit: the maximum number of referral bonuses allowed per year for that product
axes.referrer_bonus_usd: the dollar amount the REFERRER receives for one successful referral
axes.referred_bonus_usd: the dollar amount the REFERRED person or business receives as a welcome bonus
axes.qualifying_deposit_usd: the minimum dollar amount the REFERRED party must deposit to trigger the bonus
axes.deposit_window_days: the number of days the REFERRED party has to make the qualifying deposit
axes.rolling_window_referrals: the maximum number of referral bonuses allowed inside one rolling window (NOT per year) — this rule applies across account types, not to one product
axes.rolling_window_days: the length in days of that rolling window (e.g. 'rolling 9-day window')
axes.company_max_age_years: the maximum age in years, counted from formation, that a company may have and still be eligible to OPEN this account (a company older than this cannot open it)
axes.qualifying_spend_usd: the minimum dollar amount the REFERRED party must SPEND (purchases, not a deposit) to trigger the referral bonus
axes.holder_min_age_years: the minimum age in years a person must be to hold or open this account

policy_ontology._note_axes_stated: ★2026-08-09 R0 수리(x188 실측). `axes` 는 A3 정책 상수의 **문턴 정의**라, 그것을 그대로 손님 발화 추출 질문으로 쓰면 모델이 옷게 기권한다 — 손님은 '최소 요구액'을 말한 적이 없고 '낼 금액'을 말한다. 6조건(2태스크×3문맥) 전부 {} 였다. 그래서 용도별로 문장을 나눈다: `axes`=문서에서 문턴을 읽을 때 · `axes_stated`=대화에서 손님이 말한 값을 뽑을 때. 출처는 정책 축 정의의 기계적 역상이고 gold 를 보지 않았다([[23]]). `operand: stated` 인 기준의 축만 넣는다.

policy_ontology._note_doc_index: ★출처 = env 파일명뿐(`doc_<군>_<주어>_NNN.json`·빌드 시점 유도·x244·저작 0). x203 이 종류를 유도할 때 쓴 같은 규칙이다. **id 만** 적고 값·축은 적지 않는다 — x243 실측이 축 선별 없이 닫힘을 보였다(S2/S3 8/8 · 축별 문장 S1 8/8 과 동률 · 프로모션 빼면 S4 0/8). 엔진은 런타임에 파일명을 뜯지 않고 여기 적힌 것을 읽기만 한다([[59]]). 시야 = 이 색인의 크기다([[50]] ADB). || ★2026-08-24 보강 — 색인 커버리지 감사(x522)에서 **env 698 ↔ 색인 695** 로 3 문서가 누락돼 있었다. 빠진 것은 낱개가 아니라 **군 둘이 통째로**(`personal_subscriptions` 2 · `customer_support` 1). 색인에 없는 문서는 검색 서브가 **색인 경로로 영원히 못 가져온다** — 실물: `rho_bank_subscription` 은 003·024·**063(hard-0)** 의 gold 인자인데 그것을 규정하는 `doc_personal_subscriptions_rho_bank_plus_*` 가 색인 밖이었고, 063#s626729 는 궤적 전체에 `subscription` 언급이 **0건**이다(s373753 은 손님이 자발적으로 말해 우연히 구제됐다). 출처는 위 규칙 그대로 **env 파일명뿐**이라 저작 0·[[23]] 무관.
policy_ontology._note_official_names: ★명명 정책(2026-08-12 사용자 지시·명시): 상품의 공식 명칭은 doc_index 주어 슬러그의 기계 전개 **축자**다 — `sky_blue`→`Sky Blue`(Account 없음)·`gold_saver_account`→`Gold Saver Account`(Account 가 이름의 일부). 즉 `Account` 는 **이름에 포함된 경우에만** 존재하며, 덧붙이거나 떼면 다른 이름이 된다(x268 실측: 접미사를 덧붙인 값은 인자까지 생존해 채점 칸을 죽인다 S_SUFF 0/8 ↔ S_BARE 7/8). 출처 = env 파일명뿐(gold 무관·x244).

_note_policy_ontology: ★2026-08-08 A3 정책 온톨로지가 런타임 층으로 들어왔다(정본 = A3_POLICY_ONTOLOGY_DESIGN_2026_08_08). 행 = (주어, 축, 값, 인용, applies_to). 생성 `x140`(문서 전수 1회·축별 질의·축 적합성) · 결속 `x145`(§1c) · 독립 누락 검사 `x141`. **정책 상수의 유일한 런타임 출처**다 — 엔진은 여기서 조회하고 사실은 DB에서 읽어 대조만 한다(사용자 지시 2026-08-08). ⚠표적 빌드라(`targeted_contains`) §0a 완결성 주장은 이 산출물로 하지 않는다. ⚠주어 정규화 금지(§9-4) — 표기마다 행이고 각자 인용을 진다. 맞추는 것은 LLM 몫([[22]]·C316).

write_initiation.instructions: You are handling ONE decision in isolation. Below are the customer's request and the verbatim results of the audit tool already run in this conversation. Using ONLY those results, carry out the correction the policy requires now.
write_initiation.answer_format: Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"calls": [{"tool": "<tool name>", "arguments": {"<name>": <value>, ...}}]}. If the results give no basis, reply {"calls": []}.
write_initiation._note: 2026-08-14 x307~x310. 073 credit 착수는 knowing-doing 이다 — 같은 최소 문맥서 메인 실행 0/8 인데 텍스트로 물으면 knows 7/8(x307). 자리를 옮기면 서브 7/8·JSON 8/8, 근거 없으면 0/8(x308 D_NOBASIS = 날조 안 함). 그 산출을 메인에 전달하면 8/8 실행(x309 B_DELIV)·한 건만 전달해도 8/8(C_DELIV1). 메인은 전달을 권위로 받으므로(x309 D_WRONG 5/8) **엔진이 값의 근거 substring 실재만 검산하고 실패 시 폴백**한다(quote_grounding 동형·판단 0·[[25]]). 근거 동봉은 정답 팔을 안 죽인다(x310 B_CITE 8/8). ★2026-08-14 x311 일반화: answer_format 에서 도메인 필드명을 제거(B_GEN 8/8 = A_DOM 8/8 로 무손실)·basis_scope='all'(C_GEN75 0/8 → D_GEN75F 8/8 = 근거 폭이 인자). minimize-A2 위반 해소.

_note_catalog_attrs: ★출처([[23]]·2026-08-20): **구조 선언**이다 — 이 도메인의 카탈로그(계좌 클래스)가 어떤 속성을 갖고 그 값이 어떤 종류인지를 적은 것이지 행동 강제가 아니다. `_note_identifying_arg_types` 가 정한 규칙을 그대로 따른다: 구조 선언은 정책 축자 불요이되, **이 선언이 행동을 바꾸는 레버를 구동한다면 그 레버에 정책 근거가 필요하다**. || 출처 = KB 문서(`documents/doc_<family>_<class>_*`) 축자 추출 + 엔진 인용 검산(인용이 문서에 축자로 실재하고 값이 인용 안에 있을 때만 채택). `type` 은 추출이 선언한 unit 의 다수결이고 `unit_votes` 에 표를 남긴다 — 우리가 고르지 않았다. || 왜 필요한가(2026-08-20 실측): 타입 없이 비교하면 `foreign_currency_holding == 1`(존재를 뜻함)이 값 30(지원 통화 수)에 대해 벌점 |30-1|=29 를 매겨 **가장 잘 만족하는 계좌를 가장 크게 깎았다**. 그리고 `1% of withdrawal (max $3.00)` 과 `$2.50` 은 unit 없이 겨룰 수 없다. || 소비자: 측정 파이프(`x430`·`x431`)뿐 — **라이브 엔진 경로에 물려 있지 않다**([[62]] 레버 아님). || ⚠`n_documented` 는 38 클래스 중 값이 확인된 수다. `unknown` 은 문서가 값을 안 준 축이다.
_note_catalog_arg_families: ★출처([[23]]·2026-08-20): **구조 선언** — 어떤 인자의 후보가 어느 문서 계열에서 오는지를 적은 것이지 행동 강제가 아니다(`_note_identifying_arg_types` 규칙 동일 적용). 출처 = KB 문서 디렉터리의 계열 접두사(`doc_<family>_<class>_*`) — 환경 사실이다. || 왜 필요한가: 표가 6계열 60여 클래스로 넓어지면 `account_class` 후보에 신용카드가 섞인다. 계열을 안 가르면 후보 수만 부풀고 순위가 오염된다. || 소비자: 측정 파이프(`x431`)뿐 — 라이브 엔진 경로에 안 물려 있다.

spend_category._note_: 범주 자격을 **정의하는** KB 문서의 색인(2026-08-20 밤·사용자 지시 *"선택에 필요한 문서들을 A2 A3 등에 인덱스로 명확하게 기술해야 한다"*). 출처=KB 문서 **제목**(*Which … Qualify* · *What Qualifies* · *Exceptions and Exclusions* · *Rewards Categories*)뿐이고 gold 는 보지 않았다([[23]]). 근거: 전수 326 sim 에서 fit 호출의 77%가 **KB 검색 0회** 상태에서 났다(C570) — 범주를 고르는 시점에 문서가 문맥에 없다. 이 색인은 **무엇을 배달해야 하는지**를 선언할 뿐, 어느 범주가 맞는지는 말하지 않는다.

enum_priority._source_with_examples: GB2_NOTICE_BEFORE_TRANSFER 의 `ask` 에서 **연속 구간을 그대로** 들어올린 것(재작성 0). 출처 계보 = 커밋 aa657c59(2026-07-28 'day7 midrun forensic prescriptions'). ⚠[[66]] 검토 대상: 19 코드 중 **3개에만** 사례가 달려 있고 그 셋이 각각 004·014·012 가 필요로 하는 값이다 — 실패를 보고 쓴 열거일 수 있다. 내용 자체는 doc_042 표에 축자로 있어 [[23]] 출처는 서지만, **사례 선택**이 성적을 사고 있는지는 x485 F/G 가 가른다.
enum_priority._note_: 2026-08-22 x485 후속. 이 키는 **선언일 뿐 엔진이 아직 읽지 않는다**(라이브 거동 불변) — 격리 프로브 F_tier/G_examples 의 재료로만 쓰인다([[71]]②: 재료는 선언에서). 왜: x485 1차에서 정의 표만 주면 gold 0/24(전부 TIER 2 `kb_search_unsuccessful`), 표+게이트 ask 를 주면 5/24. 그런데 그 ask 에는 004 의 답을 이름으로 대는 사례가 들어 있어 이득의 출처가 **일반 규칙**인지 **사례 떠먹이기**인지 갈리지 않았다([[62]] 측정 대상 소실 위험). F(일반 규칙만) ↔ G(사례 포함)가 그것을 가른다. F 가 0 이면 이 축은 우리 레버로 못 산다.

write_rules.text: Dispute the earliest (first) transaction when multiple duplicates exist.
write_rules._note_: ★2026-08-25 신설. 격리 `x537`(085·창 3·n4): 결정점 창 그대로면 **0/12**, 이 문장을 결정점에 놓으면 **12/12**, 같은 길이의 무관한 문장이면 **0/12**([[57]] 통과). 왜 필요한가: 085 가 중복 청구에서 **늦은 거래**를 골랐다(gold `btxn_b2c3d4e5f602` ↔ 제출 `btxn_c3d4e5f6g703`·두 sim 재현). 규칙은 대화 초반 문서 본문에 **축자로 이미 도착**했고 write 는 한참 뒤였다 — `T2_SPEC_AT_WRITE` 와 같은 **거리** 문제다. 출처 = 분쟁 접수 문서 본문 축자(정책 산문·gold 아님·[[23]]). ⚠엔진은 검색도 순위도 하지 않는다 — 이 문장을 그대로 싣는다.

write_rules.text: Maximum liability by reporting timing: reported within 2 business days of the statement = $50; reported within 60 days of the statement = $500; reported after 60 days = unlimited liability, and the tool takes -1 for unlimited.
write_rules._note_: ★2026-08-25 신설. 격리 x538(085·창 5·n4): 창 그대로 **12/20** ↔ 이 표를 결정점에 놓으면 **20/20** ↔ 같은 길이의 무관한 문장 **12/20**([[57]] 통과). 합성도 쟀다 — x538b 에서 이미 실려 있는 '가장 이른 중복' 문장과 **함께** 실었을 때 `B_both` **20/20** 으로 서로 죽이지 않는다([[19]]). 왜 필요한가(t7354 라이브 실측): 085 의 유일한 미달 행에서 표기 아홉이 닫히고 나면 남는 칸이 `customer_max_liability_amount` 하나이고 제출값이 **'0'** 이다 — 표 안에 없는 값이다. 격리의 A_asis 는 '30000'·'50000' 을 8/20 냈다(라이브의 '0' 을 축자로 재현하지는 못했다 — 그 단서를 남긴다). 출처 = 문서 축자: "- Reported within 2 business days of statement: Maximum liability $50 / - Reported within 60 days of statement: Maximum liability $500 / - Reported after 60 days: Unlimited liability - customer may not recover funds" (doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_031 'Internal: Filing a Debit Card Transaction Dispute') + 도구 문서 "customer_max_liability_amount (number): ... Use -1 for unlimited liability." ⚠엔진은 어느 티어가 옳은지 판정하지 않는다 — 신고 시점을 읽는 것은 모델 몫이다([[62]]③④).

write_once_keys._note_: 2026-08-28 · t7378 task_074#s361454. `T2_DUP_WRITE` 는 그 런에서 켜져 있었는데도 막지 못했다 - `_mut_key_of` 가 인자 **전체**를 키로 쓰기 때문이다(같은 계좌에 14.5 를 적용한 뒤 30.0 을 적용 = 다른 키). 정책의 유일성 키는 **계좌**다.
write_once_keys._note_source_: 도구 설명 축자(env 출력): "The apply_checking_account_credit_5829 tool may only be called ONCE per checking account per customer interaction. After a credit is applied to a checking account, the system enforces a 14-day cooldown period" - gold 무참조([[23]]).

_note_write_once_keys: 정책이 선언한 **유일성 키**. 엔진은 이 이름들의 값을 읽어 이어 붙일 뿐이고 무엇이 유일한지는 여기서만 정한다([[05]]).
